result.title: REFORM-3D: A Representation-Centric Evaluation Framework for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models
result.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 ED Track
result.summary: Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \textbf{R}epresentation-centric \textbf{E}valuation \textbf{F}ramew\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. Project link: \href{https://endarzboy.github.io/reform3d-website/}{\highlightLR{REFORM-3D}}.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 REFORM-3D 表示中心评测框架，在冻结的 3D 医学视觉基础模型上考察采集间距扰动下的特征稳定性、跨模态解剖对齐与有限标注下的解剖迁移，并训练 Med3DINO 系列对比各向同性归一化、体素相对采样与间距感知重采样三种几何假设。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定解剖、只扰动 spacing 并度量嵌入漂移」加双向平衡检索探针的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否稳定保留任务必要的视觉与几何信息；但不涉及推理期状态生成，属 3D 医学编码器评测，迁移线索需人工核查。
